title: WMI Query Timeout - wmiPersistence Tool
problem: WMI persistence detection tool hangs on wmiPersistence query (Get-WmiObject Win32_SystemDriver), exceeds 8-second timeout
evidence: WMI queries on complex objects trigger timeout
cause: WMI classes (Win32_SystemDriver) perform expensive enumeration on first query. Subsequent queries may be cached but cold startup is very slow

recommended_actions.action: Increase WMI query timeout from 8s to 20s for cold-start protection
Cache WMI results and use CIM instead of WMI for faster queries
Pre-warm WMI repository on tool initialization

notes: Affects entire forensics investigation capability. Blocking issue for persistence detection
